simple.meaning: שְׁפַל (shᵉphal) is a Hebrew action word meaning “abase, humble, put down, subdue.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 4 times in Daniel, beginning at Daniel 4:34. The surrounding contexts include family line, death, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to שְׁפַל (H8214) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: שְׁפַל (shᵉphal) / H8214 is traced through Daniel 4:34, Daniel 5:19, Daniel 5:22, Daniel 7:24 with source-language evidence and verse context.
